# Marketing Data Quality Checklist

## Before analysis
- Metric definitions are documented.
- Source and refresh date are known.
- Time zone, currency, and filters are consistent.
- Required events and fields are present.
- Duplicate and missing records are assessed.

## During analysis
- Totals reconcile with source systems.
- Outliers and unexpected changes are investigated.
- Segment sizes are sufficient for interpretation.
- Tracking changes are annotated.

## Before sharing
- Limitations are stated.
- Personal data is removed or appropriately protected.
- Charts and labels match the underlying data.
- Owner and next refresh are recorded.
